The core product is an Electron desktop app whose dev task (`turbo run dev`) launches an Electron window with no controllable HTTP port, so it can't be health-checked by an HTTP harness. The repo's one cleanly bootable web surface is the `website/` workspace package (root scripts `docs:dev`/`docs:build`/`docs:preview` map to `pnpm --filter ligma-website dev|build|preview`), a Vite-family dev server that accepts `--port` and serves a module-script HTML shell.

Root `pnpm dev` runs `turbo run dev`, which fans out to the workspace apps (Vite renderer + Electron main per the README). Turbo's fan-out means no single --port flag or PORT variable reliably reaches the Vite task, so a fixed port on Vite's default 5173 is the only honest strategy; the health marker is Vite's injected client script, which appears in the raw HTML shell before any JavaScript runs.

Boot recipe

The root `pnpm dev` runs turbo, which launches an Electron desktop app — not health-checkable over HTTP in a throwaway checkout, and turbo doesn't forward a port flag. The only plain HTTP surface is the ligma-website package (Vite-based, per its dev/build/preview scripts), booted directly via pnpm --filter so the --port flag reaches Vite.

{
  "appDir": ".",
  "install": [
    "pnpm",
    "install"
  ],
  "dev": [
    "pnpm",
    "--filter",
    "ligma-website",
    "dev"
  ],
  "portStrategy": {
    "kind": "flag",
    "flag": "--port"
  },
  "healthPath": "/",
  "healthMarker": "/@vite/client",
  "seed": null
}

Boot recipe

The root `pnpm dev` runs turbo, which launches an Electron desktop app — not health-checkable over HTTP in a throwaway checkout, and turbo doesn't forward a port flag. The only plain HTTP surface is the ligma-website package (Vite-based, per its dev/build/preview scripts), booted directly via pnpm --filter so the --port flag reaches Vite.

{
  "appDir": ".",
  "install": [
    "pnpm",
    "install"
  ],
  "dev": [
    "pnpm",
    "--filter",
    "ligma-website",
    "dev"
  ],
  "portStrategy": {
    "kind": "flag",
    "flag": "--port"
  },
  "healthPath": "/",
  "healthMarker": "/@vite/client",
  "seed": null
}
